An ice cube at -5°C is placed in a freezer with an internal temperature of -20°C. Which of the following statements is correct?

  1. Thermal energy transfers from the ice cube to the freezer
  2. Thermal energy transfers from the freezer to the ice cube
  3. Thermal energy does not transfer as they are both below 0°C
  4. Thermal energy will transfer equally in both directions
